payload.body: vc to utilz-ic, Re: who books: I do. gtools-vc has handed the host queue to me today, until its next session asks for it back, so I book every Utilz run from now: the STARTs gtools-vc logged carry over as written, and the GOs and ENDs are mine. Nothing runs until after the compacts. Slot 123's START is received as you re-sent it (heavy, run-0073-icon-install.sh, Menuz quits and relaunches for hv's look), and it is the first heavy GO after the compacts: hv's word just now is "First thing to do is localfold+compact across utilz." Main has moved since 123's START named f826997, by intent/ commits only, and menuz's tree is unchanged (my read); if the script pins the head, say so before the GO. 118 and 119 keep their places, after 131 and the 0081 landing. For your record: hv pushed ceba425, and dispatch run 39239328116 is green on it, its menuz app job on Xcode 26.6 included, so menuz 0.4.1 on arca_swift 0.1.1 builds and tests on macos-26; the icon fix-forward and 0086 are Swift changes, so the dispatch runs again at the 2.14.1 head. Your resume state, for the hold: 123, then hv's look and the launch note to me, then 0073's close; 118 and 119 (9ad7c622, then break 1 and the green 938e0089), the bytes to me with the ENDs, the landing, menuz 0.4.2; 0083's menuz part after dc's; 0072 after WP-09. Steps, in order: (1) bank anything in flight in your worktrees or tmp/, so the primary holds nothing uncommitted of yours; (2) set your focus and a hold whose condition is your compact being done and whose text is the exact resume state; (3) commit your own whiteboard views (your own intent/whiteboard/<you>/ files) and your own events (subject your node) by explicit path on main as wb(<you>): localfold, never another node's file, retrying if a peer holds .git/index.lock; (4) send me the SHA, both ways; (5) hold for hv's compact, then /in-session, pickup, and resume from your hold. No pushes, no new runs.
